name: MonarchAiMessage
title: AiMessageView
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column and FlowRow composing MonarchAiStreamingText, MonarchAiReasoning, MonarchAiToolCall, MonarchAiToolApproval, MonarchAiSourceList, MonarchAiCitation, MonarchAttachmentChip, MonarchAiErrorMessage, MonarchAiMemoryChip, MonarchAiChainOfSteps, MonarchAiArtifactCard, MonarchAiGenerativeUi, MonarchAiEditProposal, MonarchAiMessageBranch, MonarchAiMessageActions, MonarchAiUserMessageEdit and MonarchAvatar
summary: One chat message: its text, reasoning, tool calls, sources, citations, files, memories, plans, artifacts, generated UI, edit proposals and errors in the order the model produced them, with the layout of its role, the time, the version switcher and the action row.
whenToUse: For each message of a conversation driven by MonarchAiConversation, in the app's LazyColumn of messages, so every part type gets the matching Monarch component.
whenNotToUse: For a single answer outside a conversation use MonarchAiStreamingText or MonarchAiStructuredAnswer; for a whole thread with its input use the conversation components around a LazyColumn of these messages.

options.name: message
options.description: The message: role, ordered parts, creation time, agent, feedback, branch, finish reason and queued flag.

options.name: agent
options.description: The agent shown when the message has none of its own.

options.name: agentImage
options.description: The agent's picture, loaded by the app; the avatar shows agentIcon or initials meanwhile.

options.name: announces
options.description: Whether streamed text and errors announce themselves; pass false when the thread has one announcer.

options.name: showTimestamp
options.description: Shows the time the message was created: in the header of an assistant message, in the footer otherwise.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: IANA zone of the time; null is the device's zone.

options.name: is24Hour
options.description: 24-hour clock; null follows the device setting.

options.name: showActions
options.description: Shows the action row; it is hidden while the message streams, is edited or is queued.

options.name: copyable
options.description: Shows Copy (the web's onCopy={false} hides it).

options.name: editing
options.description: Shows MonarchAiUserMessageEdit in place of the person's bubble.

options.name: speaking
options.description: Whether the app is reading the message aloud; Read aloud then reads Stop reading.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Called with the text after Copy has put it on the clipboard.

options.name: onRegenerate / onFeedback / onReadAloud
options.description: Show Regenerate, the thumbs and Read aloud on an assistant message.

options.name: onEdit
options.description: Shows Edit on the person's message.

options.name: onShare
options.description: Shows Share.

options.name: onBranch
options.description: Switches versions; the switcher shows when the message has more than one version and both version icons are given.

options.name: onRetry / onResume
options.description: Try again on a retryable error part, Resume on a resumable one.

options.name: onCancelQueued
options.description: Shows Cancel on a queued message of the person.

options.name: onForgetMemory / onEditMemory
options.description: Forget and Edit on a memory the reply saved.

options.name: onApproveTool / onDenyTool
options.description: With either, a tool call waiting for approval shows as MonarchAiToolApproval.

options.name: onAlwaysAllowTool
options.description: Offers Always allow on the approval card.

options.name: onEditSubmit / onEditCancel
options.description: Save or cancel the edit of the person's message.

options.name: onOpenArtifact
options.description: Shows artifact parts as MonarchAiArtifactCard; without it they show nothing.

options.name: onOpenFile
options.description: Makes file chips open the file.

options.name: onOpenSource
options.description: Opens a source from the list or a citation.

options.name: onOpenLink
options.description: Opens a link in the text; null opens it with the system.

options.name: uiRegistry / onUiAction
options.description: Shows ui parts with MonarchAiGenerativeUi from this allow-list; without it ui parts show nothing.

options.name: editHunks
options.description: Turns an edit proposal into hunks for a read-only MonarchAiEditProposal; null shows nothing.

options.name: renderPart
options.description: Returns content for a part, {} for nothing, or null to keep the default component.

options.name: agentIcon
options.description: The avatar's icon while there is no picture.

options.name: actionIcon / moreIcon
options.description: Glyphs of the action row; without them the actions show as text.

options.name: previousVersionIcon / nextVersionIcon
options.description: Icons of the version switcher, required for it to show.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings and the labels of each part component.

options.name: moreActions
options.description: Items of the menu of further actions.

states.name: assistant
states.description: A header with the avatar, the agent's name, role and time, then the parts at full width and the action row.

states.name: person
states.description: The parts in an end-aligned bubble on the muted background, at most 85% of the width; time and actions under it.

states.name: system or tool
states.description: The parts at full width without a header.

states.name: streaming
states.description: Text shows a caret and announces new sentences; the action row is hidden and the version switcher disabled.

states.name: finished short
states.description: A Length, ContentFilter or Refusal finish reason adds a warning-coloured notice under a finished reply.

states.name: queued
states.description: The note Queued. It will send when you are back online. with Cancel; no action row.

states.name: tool approval
states.description: A tool call waiting for approval shows Approve and Deny when the app handles them.

states.name: error
states.description: An error part shows MonarchAiErrorMessage with Try again and Resume when allowed.

appearance: The person's bubble uses the muted background with the default text color and the extra-large radius; the agent's role, the time and the queued note use the muted text color; the finish notice uses the warning strong color. Each part takes the colors of its own component, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme roles.
platformNotes: The web's AiMessageView is memoised and hides the action row until hover; on Android the row is always visible under a finished message and Compose skips unchanged messages when the app keys its LazyColumn items by message id. Callbacks do not receive the message, because the caller has it in scope. The web's onCopy={false} is copyable = false; Monarch copies with MonarchCopyButton. The avatar picture is a Painter the app loads (no URL loading). The version switcher needs app-supplied icons because Monarch bundles none. The web announces an error part only the first time it mounts; here announces controls it, so a thread that re-shows old messages should pass false. The web renders a tool call as a compact row; Android uses MonarchAiToolCall, which can expand to show input and output. iOS has no MonarchAiMessage view yet; the name follows the iOS model note that reserves it for the message view.
accessibility: TalkBack reads You said:, Assistant said: or System message: on the message before its parts.
The avatar is decorative; the agent's name is text in the header.
Copy, Edit, the version buttons and Resume have 48dp touch targets.
Citations are named Source n: title.
The finish notice and the queued note are text, not only color.
Streamed text announces new sentences politely and the last text part announces Response complete once the reply, including its tool calls, is done; announces = false turns this off.
edgeCases: Artifact, ui and edit-proposal parts show nothing until the app gives onOpenArtifact, uiRegistry or editHunks.
Several source parts show one source list, at the first source.
A citation whose source is not in the message shows nothing.
Without both version icons and onBranch the switcher is left out.
Long text wraps inside the bubble; the bubble never grows beyond 85% of the width.
The message does not scroll; put it in the app's LazyColumn.

examples.title: Assistant answer with reasoning, tool, sources and file
examples.webExample: Assistant answer with reasoning, tool, sources and file
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchAiMessage(
        message = MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = "a1",
            role = MonarchAiRole.Assistant,
            parts = listOf(
                MonarchAiReasoningPart({{reasoning.text}}, durationMs = {{reasoning.durationMs}}),
                MonarchAiToolCallPart(
                    id = {{tool.id}},
                    name = {{tool.name}},
                    input = MonarchAiJSON.Object(mapOf("query" to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{tool.query}}))),
                    state = MonarchAiToolCallState.Succeeded,
                    startedAt = {{tool.startedAt}},
                    endedAt = {{tool.endedAt}},
                ),
                MonarchAiTextPart({{answer}}),
                MonarchAiSourcePart({{source.id}}, {{source.title}}, url = {{source.url}}, kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.{{source.kind|pascal}}),
                MonarchAiCitationPart({{citation.id}}, {{citation.sourceId}}),
                MonarchAiFilePart({{file.name}}, {{file.mediaType}}, size = {{file.size}}),
            ),
            createdAt = {{createdAt}},
            agent = MonarchAiAgentRef({{agent.name}}, role = {{agent.role}}),
            branch = MonarchAiBranchPosition(index = {{branch.index}}, count = {{branch.count}}),
            feedback = feedback,
        ),
        onRegenerate = {},
        onFeedback = { feedback = it },
        onBranch = {},
    )
}

examples.title: A tool call waiting for approval
examples.setup:
val reply = MonarchAiConversationMessage(
    id = "a2",
    role = MonarchAiRole.Assistant,
    parts = listOf(MonarchAiToolCallPart("t1", "send_reminder", state = MonarchAiToolCallState.PendingApproval)),
    createdAt = "2026-11-05T09:06:00.000Z",
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web example is a 614px page with 24px targets: the number of the source, the citation chip, the file chip and the icon buttons sit close under each other. Android asks every control for a 48dp touch target, so the numbered source link, the citation chip and the action buttons keep a 48dp box and the rhythm between them is looser than on the web. The order, the data, the copy and the icons are the web's.
parityExceptions.convention: Material touch target of 48dp for every control
